maria_sales: FYI Meridian just dropped a SIG v3.0 with Q1-30. They want per-question evidence + CSV index. Deadline Tue EOD. Who can own batches?

kevin_se: I can do Q1-8 (network, infra). Will collect ACLs, FW rules, vuln scans.

kevin_se: Quick note 
- Q4 needs historical WAF rules (12mo) - archive pull may be 24h.

maria_sales: Noted. Keep items in protected share. Meridian prefers direct links for ingestion.

ops-bot: Created secure bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/meridian-1846012345/ (upload link expires 7d).

tina_security: I'll take Q9-16 (identity, keys, rotation). Any attestations need Legal review .

maria_sales: Can we produce a simple CSV (question_id,url,status) for them? Ops, can you auto-generate?

ops-bot: Uploaded starter README + CSV skeleton: s3://redwood-evidence/meridian-1846012345/meridian-index.csv

kevin_se: Dropping sample command to pull redacted logs:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/meridian-1846012345/q12/runtime-audit-redacted.json ./
jq '.events[] | {ts,user,event}' runtime-audit-redacted.json
```

tina_security: Added RBAC matrix + rotation template to bucket, flagged for legal review.

maria_sales: Action items: Kevin Q1-8 (today), Tina Q9-16 (tomorrow), Ops finalize CSV (today 4pm PT). I'll send preliminary index to Meridian after CSV is ready. Ping here if blocked.
